name: Mech-Mind Robotics Technologies Co., Ltd. Class H
summary: Mech-Mind Robotics Technologies Co., Ltd. builds core robotics technologies and products, such as 3D vision systems, dexterous robot hands and large language models for perception, understanding and decision-making. It sells in mainland China, Japan, South Korea, the United States, Canada and Europe, and its mech-eye series are industrial 3D cameras.
